'''2011 Worlds Day 3 Kevin Shannon LS Heading For The Medical Frigate''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Kevin Shannon]] at [[2011 World Championship]] (Day 3).

Sheet name field '''Shamen'''; dest [[Kevin Shannon]]. Sheet abbreviations expanded in .py notes (JK/IL-19, SITF, HCF→He's Confused, Strike Force→Strike Planning, AFA→Anger, Fear, Aggression (V)).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Heading For The Medical Frigate]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 3
